He caught the mismatch while implementing the scheme in go-ethereum, where the known-answer tests from both projects only pass with the new order.

items.title: 新 EIP 草案：Generic Proof Verification and Batching
items.note: 2026-11-13 19:21 由 Marchhill 提交，到 2026-11-14 05:00 仍在连续修改。它启用 EIP-8288 预留的 LEANSTARK_SCHEME，并加入赞助批量证明：赞助者为每个批处理叶子付一次费，成员交易按声明付费，任意有效子集都能被打包而不需要成员重新签名；折扣声明只走 builder 直连，普通单笔证明保留公共 mempool 资格。PR 写明所有 gas 数值和上限都是临时的，激活前要在给定硬件上测出满块完成时间和内存。
items.title_en: New EIP draft: Generic Proof Verification and Batching
items.note_en: Opened by Marchhill on 2026-11-13 19:21 and still being revised at 2026-11-14 05:00. It turns on EIP-8288's reserved LEANSTARK_SCHEME and adds sponsored batch proofs: a sponsor pays once per batch leaf, member transactions pay per claim, and any valid subset can be included without members signing again. Discounted claims go builder-direct only, while ordinary single proofs stay eligible for the public mempool. The PR says every gas value and bound is provisional, and activation requires measured full-block completion time and memory on stated hardware.

items.title: ERC-8499：从 BIP-39 派生哈希签名密钥
items.note: 2026-11-13 17:34 由 johba 开帖（ERC PR #2172 同日 17:41 提交）。覆盖 leanSPHINCS、SLH-DSA、WOTS、FORS、XMSS。作者列出现状：有的钱包从 BIP-39 熵用 Keccak-256 派生，有的再做一次 PBKDF2，有的对 BIP-39 seed 做 HMAC-SHA512，所以同一助记词在不同钱包里得到不同密钥。2026-11-14 02:38 的回复补充：换参数集后，恢复钱包会派生它支持的每种密钥类型，再看账户当前接受哪一个；旧密钥类型也要继续派生，因为账户地址可能是用旧密钥算出来的。
items.title_en: ERC-8499: Hash-Based Key Derivation from BIP-39
items.note_en: Thread opened by johba on 2026-11-13 17:34 (ERC PR #2172 followed at 17:41). It covers leanSPHINCS, SLH-DSA, WOTS, FORS and XMSS. The author lays out today's split: some wallets derive from the BIP-39 entropy with Keccak-256, some run a second PBKDF2, and some apply HMAC-SHA512 to the BIP-39 seed, so one phrase gives different keys in different wallets. A reply at 2026-11-14 02:38 adds that after a parameter-set change, a restoring wallet derives every key type it supports and checks which one the account accepts, and it must keep deriving retired key types because the account address may have come from the old key.

items.title: EIP-8151 新增公共 mempool 规则
items.note: 2026-11-13 13:44 推送修订、16:00 作者回复评审。背景：EIP-8151 让 ecRecover 读取被恢复地址的代码，所以 EIP-8141 Frame 交易的验证前缀调用 ecRecover 时，可能依赖第三方账户。新规则把每个被恢复的地址及其代码类别（空或已委托，还是其他代码）记为 signer 依赖，类别变化时重新验证；按被恢复地址限制待处理交易数，canonical 签名哈希和其他摘要分开配额，pay frame 的恢复按每个 paymaster 计一次。
items.title_en: EIP-8151 adds public mempool rules
items.note_en: With a revision pushed at 2026-11-13 13:44 and an author reply to review at 16:00. Background: EIP-8151 makes ecRecover read the recovered address's code, so an EIP-8141 Frame transaction whose validation prefix calls ecRecover can depend on a third-party account. The new rules record each recovered address and its code class (empty or delegated, versus other code) as a signer dependency and revalidate when the class changes. They cap pending transactions per recovered address, with separate shares for the canonical signature hash and other digests, and count pay-frame recoveries once per paymaster.

summary_en: Post-quantum account engineering moved quickly in a single day. EIP-8288 merged a fix to the leanSPHINCS public key format, and its batched proof work was folded into a new draft, "Generic Proof Verification and Batching". A new draft, ERC-8499, proposes deriving hash-based signing keys from BIP-39 phrases. Toni says core devs may revisit the Hegotá scope within two weeks and narrow it toward post-quantum, and audit findings on the EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 repricings land on November 16.
